name: Tenable
summary: Exposure and vulnerability management (makers of Nessus): scan, prioritize and remediate security weaknesses across IT, cloud and OT — for security teams of any size.
best_for: security teams and IT-mature companies that need continuous, authoritative vulnerability scanning and can remediate what it finds
skip_if: you have no one to triage and fix findings — a managed security service or a lighter scanner fits a small team better
honest_knock: Note on how we link this one, updated 28 Jul 2026: between 21 and 28 July our partner link was dead — Tenable's shop subdomain stopped resolving, so we pointed the link at Tenable's own product page and earned nothing from it. Tenable confirmed on 28 July that the links are repaired; we re-tested them that day and the link now works again, lands on the same Nessus product page, and does pay us a commission. This is serious, enterprise-grade security tooling with an enterprise price and a learning curve — not a set-and-forget scanner. You need someone who can act on the findings, or you're paying for reports nobody reads.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a year - the first commercially licensed tier (Essentials/Essentials Plus are non-commercial only)
pricing.notes: (read 2026-08-30 and re-read unchanged on 2026-10-04 on tenable.com/buy and the Nessus Essentials page) Nessus Essentials is free — a 30-day licence for 5 IPs, non-commercial only, with plugin updates delayed 30 days and no reporting, data export, compliance checks or support. Essentials Plus $199/year: 20 IPs, real-time plugin updates, basic PDF/HTML reporting, still non-commercial, free for verified students and instructors. Nessus Professional $4,790/year, $9,330.95 for two years, $13,637.54 for three — the first tier licensed for commercial use. Nessus Expert $6,790/year, $13,208.13 for two, $19,304.19 for three. Advanced Support (24x365 phone, email, community and chat) is a $400/year add-on on both. Training: $275 for a year of the Nessus Fundamentals course for one person, $385 with Nessus Advanced added. Cloud Tenable Vulnerability Management $3,500/year for 100 assets ($6,825 for two years, $9,975 for three); $3,700/year buys up to 250 assets online. Web App Scanning $6,790/year, or $3,578 for 5 FQDNs. Anything larger is a quote.
